overloads.semanticRole: The OPEN FONT PICKER command displays the system font picker dialog box.

constraints: The selected font and/or style changes are applied to the current text selection in the object with focus only if that object's 'Allow Font/Color Picker' property is checked; otherwise the command does nothing.
This dialog box is modal under Windows but not under macOS.
If the font was changed, the On After Edit form event is generated for the object.
